jobs.title: Regional Sales Manager, DACH (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Regional Sales Manager, DACH (m/w/d)

Regional Role · Remote, based in the DACH region · Reports to: Sales Director

About Everfield

Everfield acquires and builds vertical SaaS businesses across Europe. Our portfolio spans more than 40 companies serving niche markets where software is mission-critical. We take a long-term ownership approach: we buy, invest, and build. We don't flip. Seven companies are in DACH, and we expect continuous growth in portfolio size and performance across all regions.

We are building a small, high-impact HQ revenue team responsible for lifting the commercial capability of our portfolio companies: setting standards, identifying risk, and accelerating performance. The role reports to Everfield's Sales Director, who owns consistency of the revenue system across all regions, and works day to day with the region's General Director and the CEOs of its Business Units.

The Opportunity

The Regional Sales Manager (RSM) is a cluster-level revenue operator responsible for improving sales execution and accelerating organic revenue growth across a group of portfolio companies. The role partners directly with CEOs and Business Unit leaders to strengthen pipeline discipline, improve forecast accuracy, and raise commercial maturity across the region.

This is not purely an advisory role. Alongside the regional remit, the RSM is expected to take direct sales management responsibility inside Business Units where that is the fastest route to growth, giving smaller commercial teams access to experienced sales leadership they would not otherwise have. As the region scales, the ambition is that one person can hold the sales management role on behalf of several Business Units at once, applying a standard across all of them.

Success is reflected in improved revenue predictability, stronger pipeline discipline, and sustained bookings growth across Business Units.

How the Role Operates

• Two levels, one standard. The regional remit is constant: diagnostics, pipeline discipline, forecast integrity, and commercial governance across every Business Unit in the cluster. Beyond it, the role flexes. In some Business Units you will coach and support an existing sales manager. In others you will hold the sales management role yourself.

• Direct team leadership where it is needed. Where you act as sales manager, you own the team, the pipeline, the forecast, and the number, in the same way a local sales manager would, and you report into that Business Unit's CEO for delivery while remaining accountable to Everfield for how the work is done.

• You are not a seller. You do not carry a personal quota and you are not measured on deals you close yourself. You are measured on what the teams you lead and support deliver.

• Reporting. You report to Everfield's Sales Director for standards, priorities, and development. The role is a shared resource for the region rather than a function serving any single Business Unit, acting in close partnership with Group Directors, CEOs, and sales teams.

What You Will Do

Sales Execution & Commercial Acceleration

• Drive new and expansion bookings growth across the cluster, with consistent attention to prospecting, opportunity development, and account growth.

• Act as sales manager for one or more Business Units: run the weekly rhythm, set priorities, coach the team, and hold sellers to their number.

• Reduce volatility in bookings performance and increase revenue consistency across the cluster.

• Strengthen proactive sales behaviour across outbound, account expansion, renewals and opportunity reactivation.

• Improve sales execution across the full funnel, from lead generation through to closing and account retention.

• Embed sales methodology and qualification standards, and hold teams to them through evidence rather than instruction.

• Lead deal/pipeline reviews and targeted coaching to improve win rates, shorten cycle times, and build seller capability.

Pipeline Discipline & Forecast Integrity

• Improve forecast reliability across Business Units, working toward 5% variance or better.

• Define and apply opportunity qualification standards and run structured pipeline reviews.

• Ensure pipeline visibility reflects realistic execution capacity, and raise revenue risks early to Business Units and Everfield leadership, always paired with a recommended course of action rather than an open flag.

• Monitor sustained underperformance patterns and ensure corrective action plans are implemented in time to matter.

Revenue Standards & Definitions

• Act as guardian of Everfield's revenue definitions in the region: what counts as a booking, how new name is separated from back to base, how recurring value is recognised, and what enters the pipeline in the first place.

• Hold those definitions consistently, including where a Business Unit's own commercial logic pushes against them, and fix the incentive, target, or CRM design underneath rather than bending the measurement.

• Make the cluster comparable to every other region, so performance can be read the same way across the portfolio.

Commercial Governance

• Ensure transparency in quota design, attainment measurement, and sales capacity planning.

• Support commission structure alignment with business goals.

• Contribute to annual, quarterly, and monthly commercial planning by reality-checking growth assumptions against pipeline health, execution capacity, and historical feasibility.

Commercial Diagnostics

• Diagnose revenue performance across segments, teams, and funnel stages, identifying where revenue is generated, stalled, or lost.

• Produce a written diagnostic and prioritised action plan for each Business Unit you take on, naming the problem, the cause, the cost of inaction, the action, the owner, and the date.

• Prioritise your own time across the cluster on distance to target, materiality to the region, and whether a documented plan already exists.

• Provide feedback on pricing discipline, discounting practices, packaging effectiveness, and ICP conversion efficiency.

• Translate performance signals into executive-level recommendations and commercial action plans.

CEO & General Director Partnership

• Act as strategic commercial partner to CEOs and Business Unit leaders, representing Everfield's revenue expectations and performance discipline.

• Challenge growth assumptions constructively and escalate persistent underperformance when required.

What Success Looks Like

In the first 12 months:

• Full visibility into the commercial funnel, aligned with HQ reporting standards.

• Acceleration of organic recurring revenue growth across the region.

• Improved reliability of pipeline data and forecast accuracy.

• Sales pipelines that more accurately predict bookings performance.

• At least one Business Unit where you hold sales management directly and the team delivers against its number.

• Reliable visibility of quota attainment and seller productivity.

• Deal reviews embedded across portfolio sales teams, resulting in higher win rates and shorter sales cycles.

• Revenue per seller increasing steadily across the cluster.

• A documented, reusable set of playbooks and diagnostics that other regions can apply without starting again.

What We Are Looking For

• 6-10 years total experience in B2B SaaS revenue roles, with at least 3-4 years in a sales management position, accountable for a team's bookings performance and not only for personal pipeline contribution.

• Track record of consistent revenue target attainment in a management role. You have owned a number and delivered against it, not only improved process quality.

• Direct experience leading and developing a sales team, including hiring, coaching, and managing underperformance. You will do this again here, inside our Business Units.

• Track record of implementing structured pipeline management: defining stage criteria, enforcing qualification standards, running deal reviews, and improving forecast reliability.

• Experience diagnosing revenue performance across the full funnel: understanding where deals are lost, why cycles extend, and what structural issues limit growth.

• Manages through CRM data: uses pipeline data to run structured deal reviews, identify risk, and hold sellers accountable to data quality. Familiar with Salesforce or HubSpot as a management tool.

• Experience working with senior stakeholders (CEOs, founders, or general managers) on commercial performance, including navigating organisational resistance and earning trust before driving change.

• Experience adapting sales management approach across companies at different sales maturity levels: able to calibrate coaching, process rigour, and expectations to fit the context.

• German fluency required, with professional English for work across the group. European B2B SaaS market experience required.

• Commercial finance literacy is a strong advantage: reading a P&L, understanding revenue recognition, and being able to argue the return on a commercial investment.

• Private-equity-backed or multi-entity SaaS environment experience is a strong advantage.

Skills

• Structured coaching and seller development: designing and running structured 1:1s, deal reviews, and field accompaniment to build individual seller capability, not just inspect opportunities.

• Pipeline discipline and forecasting: reading a pipeline critically, identifying risk early, and improving forecast reliability.

• Change management: driving commercial process adoption across multiple teams, and building momentum without relying on formal authority.

• Documentation and knowledge scale: writing down what you diagnose and what you implement, in a form another person can pick up and run. Work that lives only in conversation does not scale across a portfolio, and anything you build for one Business Unit should be reusable in the next.

• Commercial planning and challenge: building a bottom-up view of what revenue targets are achievable, pressure-testing top-down assumptions, and presenting credible alternatives to leadership.

• Commercial storytelling: presenting clear, honest risk assessments to CEOs and senior leadership, and leading a review that drives decisions rather than just restating numbers.

  • Full Business proficiency in German and English is a must

Who You Are

• You lead teams and you influence without authority. You will manage sellers directly in some Business Units and hold no formal authority in others. Both need to work. You build trust quickly and drive change through credibility, clarity, and structured analysis.

• You are hands-on with sales execution. You are comfortable stepping into real deals, reviewing opportunities with sellers, and diagnosing pipeline issues directly with the team, without needing to be the person closing.

• You combine analytical thinking with practical commercial judgement. You interpret pipeline data, and you also understand the realities of getting deals done.

• You communicate clearly and directly. You raise commercial risks early, with a recommendation attached, and challenge assumptions constructively, including when performance doesn't meet expectations.

You are pragmatic in complex environments. Portfolio companies vary in maturity and commercial model. You bring discipline without imposing rigid process that doesn't fit the situation

Group Director interview

jobs.title: Founding Technical Project Manager
jobs.description:
Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous!

Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains.

Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times.

To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies.

BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America.

Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard.

Location

This is a full-time position based in Munich or Cologne. Following a comprehensive onboarding period at our HQ in central Zurich (minimum one month), you will work from your home location, with regular visits to customers across the DACH region.

Team collaboration matters a lot to us. You will regularly spend time with the team in person, in Zurich and at our hubs, for team days, all-hands and offsites. These visits are financially supported by blp.

Your Mission

On our largest global rollouts, connectivity is what makes or breaks the program.

These customers run several ERP systems across many entities and countries, with interfaces, master data and process variants that have grown over decades. Whether blp is usable on day one, and whether the first go-live holds its date, depends more on getting that landscape right than on almost anything else. You are the person who makes sure it is right. You sit opposite the customer's enterprise architects and IT leads, understand what their landscape actually does rather than what the documentation says, and shape the technical solution with them.

Getting this right is relentless project management as much as architecture. Requirements on a landscape this size never arrive clear. You chase them until they are: pushing the customer's IT organization for answers, going back when an answer is vague, and refusing to let an assumption stand in for a decision. You spot the major developments and the roadblocks early, while there is still time to do something about them, and you put them in front of the Senior Project Manager and into the steering committee rather than discovering them in test.

When you raise something, you bring the way through it. You prepare the discussion with the customer, make the implications clear in their language, and come with options. "We cannot do that and we will miss the go-live" is not the job. Working out what would make it possible, and what it costs, is. Where something exceeds the standard you prepare the decision rather than take it alone: options, effort, consequences, and a clear recommendation for the steering committee or for our engineering leadership.

You are the strong technical counterpart for the customer's IT organization and for the Senior Project Manager. Both rely on you to know what is actually true. You work primarily up to the first go-live, where the solution design is either right or expensive, and you are staffed by process and landscape complexity rather than by deal size.

A word on what you build. Our integration layer works like an iPaaS: connections are assembled as configuration on our own platform, specific to that customer, rather than written as code. You work in that layer yourself, so this is a hands-on role, and you document what you have configured so that the next person can understand and maintain it. What you do not do is write code that ships with the product. That distinction is what keeps a customer-specific solution from quietly becoming everyone's problem.

Two roles sit either side of you and the handoffs are clean.

With the Integrations Engineer: you define what the connection has to do and why, they build and operate it at that customer and own whether it runs. You hand them a specification, they come back with questions and constraints from the real system, and you resolve them together. When something breaks in their environment, it is theirs. When something is wrong in what was asked for, it is yours.

With the Product Engineer: when a requirement cannot be met in configuration, or when the same requirement has now appeared at the third customer, you make the case for building it into the product. You write the specification, they build it, and you are the one who confirms it actually solves the customer problem it came from. After that it is part of the standard and you configure against it like anything else.

Key Responsibilities

  • Shape the technical solution with the customer, including their enterprise architects and IT leads.

  • Turn business requirements into a clear, implementable specification.

  • Drive requirements to clarity, relentlessly. Chase the customer's IT organization until an answer is specific enough to build on.

  • Configure integrations on our platform where the standard covers it, and document what you have configured.

  • Identify precisely where the standard does not cover a requirement, and judge whether it belongs in configuration or in the product.

  • Identify major development needs and technical roadblocks early, and escalate them to the Senior Project Manager and into the steering committee while there is still time.

  • Prepare those discussions with the customer: make the implications clear, and bring options rather than a refusal.

  • Prepare scope decisions with options, effort and consequences, and bring a clear recommendation to the steering committee or to our engineering leadership.

  • Specify what the Integrations Engineer builds at the customer, and resolve the constraints they bring back from the real system.

  • Make the case for what should be built once for everyone, hand it to our Product Engineers with a proper specification, and confirm it solves the problem it came from.

  • Support the Senior Project Manager and Project Manager on technical feasibility, effort and sequencing.

  • Stay on the account through the first go-live, and hand over a solution design that is documented and maintainable.

  • Feed recurring customer requirements back to Product so the standard grows in the right direction.

What We're Really Looking For

The following key attributes ensure success in this role:

  • Relentless on Clarity – You do not accept a vague answer as an answer, and you keep going until the requirement is specific enough to build on.

  • Architectural Judgment – You can tell the difference between a requirement that deserves a custom solution and one that deserves a conversation.

  • Credibility with Architects – You hold your own with a customer's enterprise architect and earn their trust rather than deferring to them.

  • Clear Recommendations – You frame a difficult scope question so that the people who decide can actually decide, and you say plainly what you would do.

  • Translation – You move between a business requirement and a technical design in both directions without losing anything.

  • Long-Term Thinking – You design for what the customer will need in two years, not only for what unblocks the current wave.

What You Bring

  • Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field.

  • 4+ years of experience in solution design, technical consulting, enterprise integration or a technical product role.

  • Solid understanding of enterprise system landscapes: ERP systems, interfaces, master data, and how data actually moves between them.

  • Hands-on experience configuring integrations on an integration platform, or comparable low-code or configuration-driven work.

  • Experience writing specifications that engineers can build from without a translation layer.

  • Track record of driving technical clarity in a project setting, including escalating early and constructively.

  • Comfortable in customer-facing technical discussions with senior IT stakeholders.

  • Fluent in German and English, spoken and written.

  • Bonus points for hands-on experience with SAP, Microsoft Dynamics or comparable ERP systems, or with e-invoicing and EDI standards.

Benefits

  • High ownership environment – you shape your projects, outcomes, and career path.

  • Impact at scale – your work powers automation across global enterprises.

  • Cross-functional exposure – work with engineers, data scientists, and business leaders daily.

  • Real growth – fast-paced environment, steep learning curve, and structured career progression.

  • Employee ownership – be part of a majority employee-owned company with a best-in-class stock option program.

  • Amazing team – become part of a driven and collaborative group of innovators.

  • Technology exposure – be at the forefront of AI and enjoy continuous learning opportunities.

  • Visits & offsites – paid visits and stays at our HQ in Zurich, including collaborative team offsites.

Ready to build the future of ERP automation? Join us and own your impact.

Learn more about blp and our values at https://blp.digital/company/careers.

jobs.title: Werkstudent KI & Automatisierung (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Stellenbeschreibung

Hi, ich bin Felix Lippe.

Vor ein paar Jahren habe ich Lippe Personal gegründet. Heute sind wir über 25 Leute und eine der führenden Recruiting-Agenturen für medizinische Praxen in Deutschland: Ärzte, Zahnärzte, Physiotherapeuten, Pflege. Wir haben in den letzten Jahren hunderte Praxen betreut und tausende Bewerbungen für unsere Kunden generiert. Das Geschäft läuft.

Und jetzt kommt der Teil, warum ich diese Stelle ausschreibe.

Ich baue das Unternehmen gerade grundlegend um: weg von manueller Arbeit, hin zu einem KI-gesteuerten Unternehmen. Nicht als Buzzword auf der Website, sondern als echtes Projekt, an dem ich täglich selbst arbeite – mit Tools wie Claude Code, n8n und einem eigenen KI-Setup. Ich tausche mich dazu laufend mit externen KI-Agenturen und Experten aus, ich stecke tief im Thema. Was mir fehlt, ist nicht das Wissen und sind nicht die Ideen. Was mir fehlt, ist Zeit und eine rechte Hand, die mit mir baut.

Genau das ist diese Stelle.

Die Rolle: Werkstudent mit Founder-Associate-Charakter

Du arbeitest nicht „bei uns in der IT". Du arbeitest mit mir. Direkt, auf Geschäftsführer-Ebene, ohne Hierarchie-Ebenen dazwischen.

Konkret heißt das: Wir schauen uns gemeinsam an, wo im Unternehmen noch manuell gearbeitet wird, und dann bauen wir das weg. Du bekommst von mir klare Briefings, setzt eigenständig um, und wir sprechen uns in einem festen wöchentlichen Termin ab – oft auch öfter, weil ich Sparring liebe. Du bist bei strategischen Themen dabei, verstehst, warum wir Dinge tun, und siehst, wie ein Unternehmen von innen umgebaut wird. Wenn ich mich mit externen KI-Agenturen und Experten austausche, bekommst du das mit und lernst direkt daraus – genau wie ich.

Das ist der Deal: Du hebelst meine Zeit, ich gebe dir Einblicke und Verantwortung, die du als Werkstudent sonst nirgendwo bekommst.


Deine Aufgaben

  • Du baust mit KI-Tools (vor allem Claude Code) Automatisierungen für unser Tagesgeschäft: Bewerbermanagement, Reporting, Anzeigenerstellung

  • Du optimierst, automatisierst und digitalisierst Prozesse quer durchs Unternehmen – vom Vertrieb bis zum Fulfillment

  • Du setzt Workflows in n8n auf und verbindest unsere Tools miteinander (Airtable, HubSpot, GitHub)

  • Du dokumentierst, was du baust, so dass es als System im Unternehmen bleibt und wächst

  • Du bist mein Sparringspartner: Wir entwickeln gemeinsam weiter, wie dieses Unternehmen in zwei Jahren arbeitet

Was ich dir biete

  • 20 Euro pro Stunde – bewusst am oberen Ende für Werkstudenten in Düsseldorf, weil ich lieber einen richtig Guten habe als drei Mittelmäßige

  • 16 bis 20 Stunden pro Woche, flexibel um deinen Vorlesungsplan herum, in den Semesterferien gerne mehr

  • Nach der Einarbeitung weitgehend Homeoffice. Unser Office in Düsseldorf steht dir jederzeit offen

  • Professionelles KI-Setup ab Tag eins (u. a. Claude Code Max Plan) – du arbeitest mit Tools, die die meisten Unternehmen noch nicht mal kennen

  • Direkter Zugang zu allem, was ich lerne: aus dem Austausch mit KI-Agenturen, Experten und aus unseren eigenen Projekten

  • Echte Verantwortung statt Praktikanten-Aufgaben: Was du baust, läuft danach jeden Tag in einem echten Unternehmen

  • Eine Erfahrung, die dich von praktisch jedem Absolventen abhebt: Du hast nicht über digitale Transformation gelesen, du hast eine mitgebaut

So läuft der Bewerbungsprozess

Bitte kein klassisches Anschreiben, das liest hier keiner. Stattdessen:

  1. Bewerbung über das Formular – Lebenslauf plus (das ist mir am wichtigsten) ein Link zu irgendetwas, das du gebaut hast: GitHub-Repo, kleines Tool, Automatisierung, Uni-Projekt. Größe egal. Dazu zwei, drei Sätze, was du zuletzt mit KI gelöst hast

  2. Probeaufgabe – wenn deine Bewerbung passt, bekommst du eine kleine Aufgabe (zwei bis drei Stunden Aufwand)

  3. 30-Minuten-Call mit mir – wir lernen uns kennen, du stellst deine Fragen

  4. Entscheidung innerhalb von 48 Stunden. Versprochen

Ich freue mich auf dich.

Felix Lippe
Geschäftsführer, Lippe Personal GmbH


Dein Profil

Ich halte das bewusst offen, weil mir deine Denkweise wichtiger ist als dein Lebenslauf:

  • Du bist eingeschriebener Vollzeit-Student, zum Beispiel in Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Data Science oder etwas Vergleichbarem. Auch andere Studiengänge sind okay, wenn du technisch unterwegs bist

  • Du hast schon mal mit KI-Tools wie Claude Code, Cursor oder ChatGPT etwas Eigenes gebaut oder automatisiert. Muss nichts Großes sein, aber du solltest es zeigen können

  • Begriffe wie Git und Terminal schrecken dich nicht ab

  • Du denkst unternehmerisch: Du fragst nicht „was soll ich tun?", sondern „was bringt uns weiter?"

  • Du arbeitest selbstständig und brauchst niemanden, der dir dreimal am Tag über die Schulter schaut

  • Sehr gutes Deutsch in Wort und Schrift

Falls du denkst „ich habe noch nie professionell programmiert": völlig okay. Ich suche keinen fertigen Entwickler. Ich suche jemanden, der mit KI-Tools umgehen kann, Prozesse versteht und Lust hat, mit einem Gründer ein Unternehmen umzubauen. Das ist ein eigenes Handwerk – und ehrlich gesagt eines der wertvollsten, die man 2026 lernen kann.

jobs.title: Recruiter / Talent Acquisition Manager (all genders)
jobs.description:
Wir öffnen eine neue, zentrale Position in unserem Team: eine Person, die Recruiting nicht als Aufgabe, sondern als Handwerk und Hebel für Unternehmenserfolg versteht. Du übernimmst Verantwortung für die Besetzung von Rollen über alle Funktionen und Senioritätsstufen hinweg – von Fachexpert:innen bis Führungspositionen – und gestaltest gleichzeitig aktiv mit, wie Talent Acquisition bei uns strukturell und strategisch weiterwächst.

Wir suchen jemanden, der im Recruiting bereits angekommen ist - mit fundierter Praxis, einem klaren Verständnis für die Mechanik guter Prozesse und dem Ehrgeiz, den Bereich aktiv mitzuprägen. Du bewegst dich souverän zwischen operativer Exzellenz und strategischem Weitblick, zwischen Tempo und Präzision, zwischen Beratung und klarer Kante gegenüber Stakeholdern bis auf C-Level.

Recruiting bei uns ist kein ruhiges Gewässer. Es ist schnell, anspruchsvoll und ergebnisorientiert. Genau das soll dich reizen, nicht abschrecken.

Was du bewegst

Operative Verantwortung

  • End-to-End-Ownership vielfältiger Recruiting-Prozesse – unterschiedliche Funktionen, unterschiedliche Level, unterschiedliche Herausforderungen

  • Sparringspartner:in für Hiring Manager, Leadership und C-Level – von der Anforderungsschärfung bis zur finalen Entscheidung

  • Strukturierte, kompetenzbasierte Interviewführung mit hohem Anspruch an Qualität und Fairness

  • Aktive Marktbearbeitung durch gezieltes Sourcing

  • Eine Candidate Experience, die auch unter Zeitdruck überzeugt

Strategisches Ownership

  • Mitgestaltung des Talent-Acquisition-Bereichs in enger Abstimmung mit dem Head of - strukturell, prozessual, strategisch

  • Volle Verantwortung für den Recruiting-Funnel: Kennzahlen definieren, Conversion steigern, Engpässe erkennen, konsequent nachschärfen

  • Aufbau strategischer Talent Pools für Profile, die immer wieder gefragt sind

  • Entwicklung von Active-Search-Strategien

  • Verantwortung für Recruiting-Tools und -Systeme - von Auswahl bis Optimierung

  • Aufbau externer Partnerschaften, die unser Recruiting schlagkräftiger machen


DAS BRINGST DU MIT

  • Praktische Recruiting-Erfahrung, im Idealfall bereits über mehrere Funktionen und Senioritäten hinweg

  • Ein geschärftes Verständnis für strukturierte, datenbasierte Recruiting-Prozesse und Active Sourcing

  • Souveränität und Verhandlungsgeschick im Umgang mit anspruchsvollen Stakeholdern bis in die Geschäftsführung

  • Die Fähigkeit, gleichzeitig operativ tief einzusteigen und strategisch den Überblick zu behalten

  • Belastbarkeit und einen kühlen Kopf, wenn mehrere kritische Suchen parallel unter Druck stehen

  • Ein analytischer Blick auf Funnel, Kennzahlen und Prozessqualität

  • Verbindlichkeit, Beratungsstärke und den Mut, auch unbequeme Empfehlungen auszusprechen

  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse

 

NOCH FRAGEN?

Wir freuen uns auf deine Nachricht und helfen dir gerne weiter!

DAS BIETEN WIR

  • Office Foodji & Lunchit App: Immer bestens versorgt bei uns im Office oder Remote

  • bAV: Mit der Degura Pension Cloud sichern und bezuschussen wir jetzt schon deine Rente

  • Spendit Card: Wir stocken dein Gehalt auf! Mit Spendit stehen dir bis zu fünfzig Euro netto im Monat on top zur freien Verfügung

  • EGYM Wellpass: Mit uns bleibst du fit & wir bringen dich deutschlandweit in die angesagtesten Fitness- und Wellnessstudios

  • JobRad: Spring mit uns aufs Rad und lease dir dein Traumrad oder Pedelec

  • KITA/Kiga Kostenzuschuss: Wir bezuschussen deine Kosten für die Kinderbetreuung, damit deine Kinder immer bestens versorgt sind

  • Mitarbeiterrabatte: Du erhältst attraktive Promotions und Discounts verschiedener Brands

  • Food Tastings: Teste dich mit unserem Foodteam durch unsere Produkte und gestalte unser Sortiment von morgen

  • Development: Deine Weiterentwicklung liegt uns am Herzen und mit regelmäßigen Feedbackgesprächen und Trainings bieten wir dir spannende Entwicklungspfade – z. B. vom SDR zum Account Executive

  • Flexwork: Arbeite 30 Tage im Jahr aus dem EU Ausland

  • Top Office Lage: Genieße eine erstklassige Arbeitsumgebung im Münchener Glockenbachviertel mit der Isar vor der Tür

  • Team Events: Wir sind ein Team - beim Skiday, Frühstück, Culture Week oder Office Party feiern wir gemeinsam!

ÜBER UNS

Hi, schön, dass du da bist! Wir sind Foodji - ein Team aus Food-Lovern & Tech-Nerds.

Unsere Mission ist es, frisches, gesundes und vor allem leckeres Essen überall dort anzubieten, wo Menschen den Großteil ihres Alltags verbringen – in Büros, ganz gleich, ob im Gewerbegebiet oder mitten in der Stadt, während langer Schichten im Krankenhaus oder in den Tiefen einer Produktionshalle, in der rund um die Uhr Menschen arbeiten. Überall bieten wir vollwertige Gerichte, Snacks und Getränke genau dort an, wo und wann du sie brauchst.

Proprietäre Technologien, selbstlernende Algorithmen und effiziente Lieferketten helfen uns dabei, das Paradox zwischen frischem Essen, Verfügbarkeit und Nachhaltigkeit aufzulösen. Mit unserer eigens entwickelten Technologieplattform optimieren wir die Mengenplanung und sagen Food Waste den Kampf an. Wir wollen einen positiven Effekt erzielen – auf die Umwelt, den Alltag unserer Kund:innen und unsere Communities. Deshalb spenden wir übrig gebliebene Gerichte an Foodsharing und andere soziale Initiativen direkt vor unserer Haustür.

Als Marktführer versorgen wir mit Foodji bereits täglich Tausende Menschen in ganz Deutschland. Zu unseren Kund:innen zählen unter anderem der Münchner Flughafen, Klarna, Enpal und Wingcopter. Und wir fangen gerade erst an: Allein in Deutschland gibt es mehr als 100.000 relevante Standorte für uns.

Trage auch du deinen Teil dazu bei und bewirb dich jetzt.

jobs.title: Senior Product Designer, Design Systems
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Hi, we're DuckDuckGo, the online protection company and remote-first team of 300+ on a mission to raise the standard of trust online. Founded in 2008 and profitable since 2014, annual revenue now exceeds $100m USD and millions use our browser on on Mac, Windows, iOS, and Android, our search engine, and the DuckDuckGo subscription. We also offer private, useful, and optional AI, including Duck.ai, which lets you chat privately with ChatGPT, Claude, and other AIs, all in one place. Our culture of trust, inclusivity, and empowered project management underpins everything we do, where each team member takes full ownership of their projects, from scoping and execution to postmortem. If you're seeking end-to-end ownership of your work, you've come to the right place!

 

Your Team and Role

As a Senior Product Designer, Design Systems you'll be the first of its kind at DuckDuckGo. You'll take ownership of our design system at a pivotal moment, with a chance to define both a role and a roadmap from the ground up — helping build the process, not just step into one. You'll audit our existing system, lead projects that move it forward across platforms and products like Duck.ai and Search, as well as shape how we manage and scale it as we grow.

 

Applying your hands-on design skills, you will autonomously lead highly impactful projects that scale across millions of users, and collaborate with team members at all levels to pioneer new solutions as we build out the privacy layer for the internet. From ideation to execution, you'll assess vague problems, propose high-impact solutions, and execute them against a set of success criteria. You'll have a voice in all product-related design decisions, whether large or small, and an opportunity to work on a team dedicated to our ethical, privacy by design approach. Read more about Design at DuckDuckGo on our blog: https://spreadprivacy.com/ethical-by-design/

 

About You

  • 7+ years of experience in product or design systems roles, including 2+ years in senior-level design positions at significant global consumer brands

  • Demonstrable track record of building and scaling complex and established systems

  • Ability to lead the future of our design system, from audit, recommending solutions, and planning their rollout via quick wins or large-scale projects

  • Ability to communicate recommendations and prioritization with clear documentation, success metrics, resources, and rationale which stakeholders, designers, and engineers can confidently act on

  • A knack for balancing structure with scale by creating frameworks (tokens, libraries) that hold up across platforms and teams without sacrificing craft

  • Deep knowledge of design tools, such as Figma, that are key to evolving and maintaining the design system

  • Experience bridging design and engineering practices, including creating shared nomenclature and workflows that map across tools and platforms

  • Accustomed to applying agentic and AI-driven solutions into design system management and maintenance workflows, to both accelerate and elevate how the system scales

  • Enjoy pushing creative limits while solving challenging design problems and delivering on delight, craft and exceptional quality

  • Ability to communicate visual and interaction recommendations with high-quality mockups, prototypes, and rationale

  • Skills to manage ambiguity and wrangle vague problems, propose innovative solutions, and execute them with a focus on metrics

  • Ability to take initiative in generating ideas and carrying them forward with urgency and discretion, while working openly and collaboratively

Compensation

$178,500 USD annually and stock options. Compensation is transparent across the organization, and all team members within the same professional level and global region receive the same compensation.

 

Eligibility for company-sponsored health benefits is limited to team members based in the United States. This program does not extend to team members located in other countries, such as Canada or the UK.

 

Our Team Member Support Guide explains how we prioritize your wellbeing including paid parental leave, office setup, and co-working allowances.

 

Hiring Process

Who We Are

At Partnerize, we're on a mission to transform the way businesses grow. We've built the leading partnership automation platform that empowers brands to discover, engage, and convert their audiences at scale. From affiliate marketing to influencer collaborations, we help our clients build and manage profitable partnerships that drive real results. We're a team of passionate problem-solvers who are dedicated to helping our clients win in the ever-evolving world of digital marketing.

Why Join Us

We're looking for passionate, talented people who want to be part of a winning team. At Partnerize, you'll find a culture of collaboration, innovation, and respect. We're guided by our core values, and we're committed to creating an environment where everyone can do their best work. We also offer a competitive salary, generous benefits, and a flexible work environment that allows you to thrive both personally and professionally. If you're ready to grow your career and make a difference, we'd love to hear from you.

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer to join our engineering team and champion the deployment architecture that drives our platform maturity. You'll be embedded within our engineering teams, optimizing day-to-day delivery across our on-premise estate while acting as the key engineering stakeholder to help shape, configure, and roll out our new Kubernetes platform, modernising how we deploy and scale workloads.

This is a hands-on role with real impact. You won't be rubber-stamping tickets; you'll have true autonomy over our CI/CD pipelines, automated guardrails, and migration strategies, shaping how engineering safely and rapidly ships value to production.

 

What You'll Be Doing

BAU & Platform Stability

  • Utilise and contribute to Ansible-based deployment automation to facilitate seamless product feature releases, adhering to established TechOps peer-review processes.
  • Monitor application-level health within the cluster, collaborating with TechOps on incident response and driving post-mortems for engineering-led deployments.
  • Maintain clear documentation, deployment runbooks, and developer self-service guides to streamline the engineering onboarding and release processes.

Kubernetes 

  • Represent Engineering as a key stakeholder in platform design: Collaborate with TechOps to shape engineering self-service workflows, guardrails, and standards. This includes contributing requirements for Kubernetes primitives (such as Gateway API, RBAC, admission controllers, and resource policies) to ensure engineering teams can move fast safely, without compromising core platform stability.
  • Standardise application-level configurations: Work alongside TechOps to establish clear engineering standards within the namespaces for ingress, RBAC, namespacing strategy, and secrets management.
  • Drive phased application migrations: Partner with engineering teams to containerise and migrate existing workloads to Kubernetes, starting with non-critical environments to establish confidence before moving business-critical systems.
  • Build robust deployment pipelines: Establish CI/CD workflows for Kubernetes-based deployments (using Helm, Kustomize, ArgoCD, or similar) with automated guardrails to ensure fast, repeatable, and safe code delivery.
  • Implement application observability: Set up application-level metrics, logging, and alerting within the namespaces, ensuring engineering teams have the visibility they need to monitor workload health.
  • Create developer self-service documentation: Document deployment runbooks, manifest templates, and best practices so that engineers can onboard and self-serve safely within the established guardrails.

 

What We're Looking For

Must-Have

  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills: we're a people-first culture where teamwork is paramount. On highly technical projects with many moving parts, the ability to collaborate openly, communicate clearly, and bring people with you is just as important as technical ability
  • Strong, demonstrable experience with Ansible: roles, inventories, vault, idempotency, the lot
  • Comfortable with Docker and Docker Compose in production environments
  • Understanding of networking fundamentals
  • Strong scripting ability: Bash and Python
  • Experience with GitOps tooling: ArgoCD or Flux
  • Experience with observability tooling (Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Alertmanager or equivalent)
  • Ability to think creatively within constraints and plan pragmatically around them: our stack is real-world, not greenfield-perfect, and we need someone who can deliver iteratively, working with what exists today while roadmapping towards the ideal state
  • A methodical, security-conscious approach

Nice-to-Have

  • Familiarity with Helm chart authoring and management
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform (even in an on-prem context)
  • Experience with secrets management tooling (HashiCorp Vault, Sealed Secrets, External Secrets Operator)
  • Prior experience in a role where you balanced greenfield work alongside BAU responsibilities

 

The Kind of Person We're After

  • You're comfortable being the person engineering teams come to when something's on fire, and you're also comfortable saying "let me schedule that properly" when it isn't
  • You can hold your own in a conversation with a software engineer, a network engineer, and senior leadership  even if they all want different things
  • You write things down. Runbooks and diagrams: you treat documentation as part of the job, not an afterthought
  • You have opinions about how things should be done, but you're pragmatic; you know when to pick the right tool vs. the perfect tool
  • Autonomously drive outcomes: we're looking for people who demonstrate intent and take initiative, not those who wait to be told what to do next

 

What We Offer

  • True ownership of the delivery lifecycle: The autonomy to shape how we ship code, build pipelines, and automate guardrails, moving entirely away from manual ticket execution.
  • A pivotal role in our cloud-native transformation: The opportunity to act as the key engineering stakeholder shaping our migration to Kubernetes, partnering closely with TechOps to build a modern, scalable platform.
  •  A progressive engineering culture: A collaborative, forward-thinking team that values automation, continuous improvement, and building modern delivery standards.

 

We welcome applications from candidates who don't tick every box. If you've got strong Ansible and Kubernetes experience and the right mindset, we'd love to hear from you.

UK Benefits & Perks

  • 25 days holiday in addition to bank holidays 
  • Enhanced Parental Leave: 6 months full pay for birth parent, 4 weeks non-birth parent at full pay after one year employment
  • 5 extra 'Partnerize Parental Days' each year
  • Private Medical and Dental Insurance 
  • Enhanced pension contributions
  • Cycle to Work scheme 
  • Eye Care Vouchers 
  • Life Assurance
  • Enhanced Wellness Program including access to EAP, Wellness Coaching & Wellness Programs
  • Regular company events and activities

Our Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion

We are committed to attracting, developing, and advancing our outstanding team members, regardless of race, ethnic identity, sexual orientation, religion, age, gender, gender identity, physical abilities, or any other dimension of diversity. We strive to foster an environment where people can be their authentic selves, raise concerns and innovate, all without fear; where they are treated fairly and respectfully, have equal access to opportunities and resources and can contribute fully to the organization's success. Every individual in our business is expected to live this commitment without exception.

jobs.description:
Established in 2004, OLIVER is the world's first and only specialist in designing, building, and running bespoke in-house agencies and marketing ecosystems for brands. We partner with over 300 clients in 40+ countries and counting. Our unique model drives creativity and efficiency, allowing us to deliver tailored solutions that resonate deeply with audiences. 

As a part of The Brandtech Group, we're at the forefront of leveraging cutting-edge AI technology to revolutionise how we create and deliver work. Our AI solutions enhance efficiency, spark creativity, and drive insightful decision-making, empowering our teams to produce innovative and impactful results. 

Role: Senior Account Manager (3 Month FTC)

Location: Remote working with 1-2 days in Slough onsite with clients

About the role: 

As Senior Account Manager, you're the primary client partner for Client — building relationships that go beyond day-to-day delivery to become a genuine strategic voice within their business. Within a studio of 20–30 dedicated agency professionals, with 1–3 direct reports, you'll be accountable for account health, commercial performance, and the quality of every client interaction. Reporting to the Brand Partner, you'll work closely with Project Managers to keep delivery on track and clients engaged. You'll also play an active role in identifying new business opportunities — introducing OLIVER and Inside Ideas Group capabilities where they add real value.

What you will be doing: 

  • Lead the client relationship with Client across all levels of the organisation, acting as a trusted advisor and strategic digital partner
  • Take accountability for the commercial health of the account — profitability, forecasting accuracy, fee negotiation, and regular financial reporting to the Brand Partner
  • Oversee project delivery, run rates, and client satisfaction through structured WIPs and proactive account management
  • Act as the escalation point for gaps in client or internal SLAs — capturing issues, proposing solutions, and working with the Brand Partner, Business Director, and Head of Operations to resolve them
  • Identify and develop new business opportunities within the account, connecting the right OLIVER capabilities to the right client needs
  • Negotiate clear, fair outcomes with clients on behalf of your team — balancing expectations, capacity, and quality
  • Manage, coach, and develop 1–3 direct reports, creating the conditions for strong performance and professional growth
  • Collaborate closely with Project Managers to ensure every project is delivered on time, on brief, and to the highest standard
  • Manage project-level and account-level budgets, including cost estimation, purchase orders, invoicing, and reconciliation
  • Source and negotiate with freelancers and production partners where required
  • Produce regular, accurate financial reports for the Brand Partner and Business Director
  • Identify and flag budget risks early, with clear recommendations for mitigation

What you need to be great in this role: 

  • Proven account management experience within a creative, digital, or integrated agency — ideally with exposure to embedded or in-house studio models
  • Strong client relationship skills, with confidence engaging at senior client levels and building long-term partnerships
  • Commercial acumen: experience managing budgets, forecasting, fee negotiation, and identifying revenue growth opportunities
  • Strategic thinking across digital, social, creative, data, and production — with the ability to contribute ideas and challenge briefs constructively
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including confident presentation and stakeholder management
  • Experience managing and developing junior team members, with a collaborative and supportive leadership style
  • Understanding of how to integrate effectively with a client-side team while maintaining high agency standards
  • Familiarity with FMCG brands or consumer goods markets is an advantage
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office and relevant workflow or project management platforms
  • Experience managing project-level and account-level budgets, including cost estimation, supplier negotiation, and financial reconciliation
  • Confidence presenting financial performance to senior stakeholders and proactively flagging risks
  • Advanced use of Gen AI tools to enhance account management, client communications, and team workflows
  • Experience building and refining AI-assisted processes for yourself and the team
  • Ability to train others on effective Gen AI use within an account management context
  • Agentic approach to complex, multi-step client challenges — able to break down ambiguity and drive clear paths forward
  • Sound understanding of AI capabilities and limitations, with consistent human oversight applied to all outputs

Please note: candidates must currently reside in the UK and be able to work in the UK without sponsorship.

Convene Hospitality Group (CHG) operates a global portfolio of lifestyle brands focused on creating places and experiences that bring people together. The company designs, develops, and operates hospitality-driven destinations to host gatherings of all kinds, ranging from small corporate meetings to immersive brand activations and beyond. We love bringing people together in person, and that passion for great experiences extends to our employees as well. If you're interested in creating inspiring moments of connection, consider joining our team.

The Senior Event Production Manager (Planning) is responsible for overseeing the planning and execution of events, ensuring seamless coordination between clients and internal teams. Acting as the primary point of contact for clients throughout the planning process, this role ensures that all aspects of an event – from logistics and technical production to catering and on-site operations – are delivered to the highest standard. The role requires strong leadership, project management, and communication skills to ensure client expectations are met while maintaining operational efficiency.

Key responsibilities:

Team Leadership & Management

  • Lead and manage the Events Team, ensuring effective staff scheduling and resource allocation.
  • Conduct biannual appraisals and regular one-to-one meetings with direct reports, providing training and professional development plans.
  • Ensure all team members adhere to company policies and procedures, including compliance with statutory Health & Safety training requirements.
  • Maintain high standards of performance and service delivery within the team.
  • Ensure strong cross-functional collaboration with other departments, including Sales and Operations.
  • Oversee team performance management, including probation reviews, performance improvement plans, and disciplinary procedures where required.

Events Planning & Coordination: 

  • Oversee the planning and execution of events across physical, hybrid, and virtual formats.
  • Act as the main client liaison during the planning phase, ensuring clear communication and alignment with their requirements.
  • Develop and maintain detailed event documentation, including Programme Execution Orders (PEOs), room layouts, event timelines, and client deliverables.
  • Conduct client kick-off meetings, providing guidance on deadlines, requirements, and production schedules.
  • Collaborate with internal teams, including AV production, catering, and operations, to finalise event logistics.
  • Ensure all pre-event planning milestones are met, providing regular updates to stakeholders.
  • Manage client expectations regarding event capabilities and work with Product and Design teams on potential platform improvements.
  • Facilitate pre-event and post-event debriefs with internal teams and clients, ensuring continuous improvement.

Operational Excellence:

  • Work closely with the Sales Team to support pre-sales activities, advising on event feasibility, logistics, and timelines.
  • Assist in the creation of event proposals, room diagrams, and other pre-sales materials.
  • Oversee event budget management, ensuring accurate cost calculations, approvals, and final invoicing.
  • Supervise on-site event operations, ensuring smooth execution and addressing any challenges in real time.
  • Ensure the team adheres to company service standards and hospitality protocols at all times.
  • Lead weekly event meetings and Programme Execution Order (PEO) discussions, ensuring alignment across all stakeholders.

Skills & Experience

Essential:

  • Extensive experience in event planning and production, with a strong background in physical, hybrid, and virtual event formats.
  • Proven leadership and team management experience.
  • Strong organisational and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple events simultaneously.
  • Excellent client relationship management and communication skills.
  • Knowledge of AV production, catering logistics, and event operations.
  • Proficiency in event management software and project management tools.
  • 2 years experience in large-scale corporate event planning.

Desirable:

  • Familiarity with virtual event platforms and livestream production.
  • Budget management experience within an events setting.

We're Here For You:

At Convene Hospitality Group, we want you to feel supported in every part of your life. Here's what you can expect:

  • Health & Wellness: Private medical insurance, subsidised fitness and eye care, plus well-being and personal support programs. Because your well-being matters, inside and outside of work.
  • Time Off & Balance: 25 days annual leave, bank holidays, and company sick pay.
  • Financial Benefits: Bonus scheme, interest-free loans for rail travel or further education, and a Cycle to Work program. We invest in you so you can grow personally and professionally.
  • Growth & Recognition: Career development opportunities and programs to celebrate your achievements.
  • Community & Impact: Volunteer, donate, and make a real impact through your work.

At Convene Hospitality Group, we believe great teams are built by bringing together people with different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences. Our values of GRIT (Genuine, Relentless, Integrity, and Teamwork) shape how we show up for each other every day. We want everyone here to feel welcome, supported, and free to be themselves. If you're excited to grow, learn, and make an impact, we'd love to have you on the team.

Convene Hospitality Group is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives.

jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist (Economist)
jobs.description:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

The Data & Science Org

At Deliveroo we have an outstanding data science organisation, with a mission to enable the highest quality human and machine decision-making. We work throughout the company - in product, business and platform teams - using analysis, experimentation, causal inference and machine learning techniques. We are uniquely placed to use data to help make better decisions and improve data literacy across Deliveroo.

Data Scientists at Deliveroo report into our data science management team, and we have a highly active data science community, with guest lecturers, study groups, mentorship programmes, a robust technical review process, and plenty of opportunities to learn new things. Data Scientists can equally progress as technical leads (individual contributors) and as people managers.

Our data scientists come from all kinds of backgrounds but have excellence in common. Many are formally trained in data science, many are not. We celebrate difference and have a dedicated data science diversity committee.

As an Economist at Deliveroo you will help scale our business and improve the experience for restaurants, riders, and eaters. Using experimental or observational data, you will get to help answer questions like:

  • Which markets/cities should we enter next?

  • How can we incentivise good rider behaviour?

  • What is the business impact of exclusive deals we have with restaurants?

  • Can the Delivery food market sustain multiple players?

  • What are the trade-offs we face when choosing between growth and profitability? How should we decide between them?

  • What is the optimum selection and variety of restaurants?

  • What impact do online reviews have?

  • How will a change in the user interface affect customer choice behaviour?

The work you will do will have a direct, measurable impact on the bottom line of the company.

Requirements:

  • Masters Degree or PhD in Economics or Econometrics (preferred)

  • Always curious and willing to learn new skills

  • A problem solver with a deep analytical mindset

  • Ability to think creatively and insightfully about business-relevant economic problems

  • A critical thinker with very strong attention to detail

  • Proficiency with analytical tools like R/Python and familiarity with SQL

  • Ideally industry experience since the completion of your academic career

  • Excellent people skills — you'll be meeting with stakeholders to translate business needs into economic problems

At Deliveroo these are just some of the tough problems we are solving - and there is no challenge that cannot be yours. The scope for growth and personal impact is enormous.

Why Deliveroo
Our mission is to transform the way you shop and eat, bringing the neighbourhood to your door by connecting consumers, restaurants, shops and riders. We are transforming the way the world eats and shops by making access to food and products more convenient and enjoyable. We give people the opportunity to buy what they want, as they want it, when and where they want it.

We are a technology-driven company at the forefront of the most rapidly expanding industry in the world. We are still a small team, making a very large impact, looking to answer some of the most interesting questions out there. We move fast, value autonomy and ownership, and we are always looking for new ideas.

Workplace & Benefits
At Deliveroo we know that people are the heart of the business and we prioritise their welfare. Benefits differ by country, but we offer many benefits in areas including healthcare, well-being, parental leave, pensions, and generous annual leave allowances, including time off to support a charitable cause of your choice. Benefits are country-specific, please ask your recruiter for more information.

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We're committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

jobs.description:
OUR MISSION

To become the car-changing destination of choice. By combining technology, media and deep automotive expertise, we’ve turned how people buy, sell, advertise and lease cars on its head.

What started as a simple reviews site is now one of the largest online car-changing destinations in Europe. Last year alone we grew over 50% with nearly £3bn worth of cars bought on site, while £1.8bn of cars were listed for sale through our Sell My Car service.

In the last couple of years we have gone big and acquired both Carwow Leasey, a leasing broker, and Autovia, creators of AutoExpress and Evo magazines, doubling our audience overnight. Together we now have one of the biggest YouTube channels in the world with almost 10m subscribers and over 1.1 billion annual views, while we sell 1.2 million print copies of our magazines and have an annual web content reach of over 350 million. We also launched our successful Sell My Car business in Germany. We are continually driving to make Carwow the go-to destination for people looking to change their car.

And we’re a long way from done!

LEGAL & COMPLIANCE @ CARWOW

Our fantastic legal team has been compared to a set of high-performance tyres, enabling Carwow to drive and corner at high speeds whilst keeping Carwow firmly on the road in all conditions. As the business pushes forward with bold ambitions, the legal team’s purpose is clear: to drive Carwow’s growth with integrity and confidence – and that’s where you come in!

YOUR MISSION

We are a platform that sits right in the middle between consumers and OEMs/Dealers in the car-changing journey. Datasits at the heart of everything we do and we want to commercialise it responsibly.

As Senior Privacy Counsel, you will be Carwow’s dedicated in-house privacy lawyer and operational privacy lead, playing a pivotal role in enabling the business to grow and scale at pace with integrity. This is an exciting opportunity to develop your career in a complex, high-growth and data-thirsty marketplace business.

We are looking for a Senior Privacy Counsel who wants to do more than provide legal advice from the sidelines. This is a rare opportunity to join a high-performing legal function as our first dedicated in-house privacy hire, taking ownership of the day-to-day privacy programme while acting as a senior legal and strategic advisor to the business as it sharpens its privacy governance programme and steers towards further growth and an exit.

We are not at “Day Zero”. We currently have an external DPO, established policies, templates, a RoPA and a risk register.

We need a tech-fluent privacy lawyer who is equally comfortable advising and doing: someone who can interpret complex legal requirements, exercise sound legal judgement and provide pragmatic advice, but who will also roll up their sleeves and build, operate and continuously improve the mechanisms that make privacy work in practice.

You will have the mandate to lift the lid on our technology stack, validate our data flows, identify legal and operational privacy risks and work directly with our Product, Engineering, Data, Marketing and commercial teams to keep the business safe and moving fast.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Privacy governance and framework development: Own, develop and maintain Carwow’s enterprise privacy governance framework, encompassing internal policies, ROPAs, privacy notices, risk registers, retention schedules and associated controls. Interpret applicable legal requirements and ensure our documentation and processes reflect the reality of Carwow’s technology stack and processing activities, leading remediation where discrepancies or risks are identified.

  • Legal advice and business partnering: Act as Carwow’s principal in-house legal advisor on privacy and data protection matters. Develop strong business partnering relationships across Marketing, Media, Product, Engineering, Data and other parts of the business, providing pragmatic, risk-based legal advice that enables commercial objectives while appropriately managing privacy risk. Provide advice to senior management and support the General Counsel in updating the Company’s Senior Leadership Team and Executives as needed.

  • Culture & Training: Build a strong internal perception of privacy as a “trust builder”. Design and deliver role-specific training that is engaging, commercially relevant and free of unnecessary legal jargon, helping teams understand both their legal obligations and how to apply them in practice.

  • Breach response: Lead the privacy aspects of data breach and incident response, working cross-functionally to investigate incidents, assess legal and regulatory risk, determine notification obligations and oversee remediation. Liaise with the external DPO, regulators and other relevant stakeholders as appropriate.

  • DPAs, DSAs and data contracting: Draft, review and negotiate DPAs, DSAs and other data protection provisions and agreements arising from commercial arrangements. Provide practical legal advice on controller/processor relationships, data sharing, international transfers and related privacy risks.

  • DSARs and individual rights: Own and continuously improve Carwow’s processes for responding to data subject rights requests, ensuring requests can be handled lawfully, efficiently and with minimal disruption to the business. Provide legal guidance on complex or sensitive requests where required.

  • Retail Media and Ad Tech: Provide legal and operational privacy support on new commercial propositions looking to leverage Carwow’s data for third-party audience targeting, segmentation and advertising. Advise on the appropriate use of personal data, profiling, consent and data-sharing structures and help design commercially workable and legally robust mechanisms for using and sharing data.

  • Product, Data and Technology: Work closely with Data & Insights, IT, Engineering and Product teams throughout the product lifecycle to embed Privacy by Design. Lead or support privacy assessments, identify legal and operational risks in new products and processing activities, and translate complex technical data flows into clear, risk-based advice for the General Counsel, Executives and wider business.

  • Operationalise Compliance: Own and operate core privacy compliance processes, including DPIAs, LIAs and data-sharing assessments. Look continuously for opportunities to integrate these into existing business workflows, with an eye on making compliance proportionate, scalable and automated wherever possible.

  • Regulatory developments: Monitor and interpret relevant developments in privacy, data protection, digital regulation and related areas, assess their impact on Carwow and translate new legal requirements into practical changes to products, policies, controls and business processes.

  • Corporate work: Provide privacy legal support on M&A, funding and other corporate transactions, including conducting privacy due diligence, identifying material risks and supporting remediation and integration activity.

  • AI and emerging technology: Advise on the privacy implications of AI and emerging technologies adopted or developed across the business, while supporting the development of practical governance mechanisms that allow Carwow to innovate responsibly.

  • Multi-jurisdictional: Support Carwow’s businesses across the UK, Germany, Spain and Portugal, advising on relevant local and European privacy requirements and working with external counsel where specialist local advice is required.

KEY REQUIREMENTS

  • A qualified lawyer, admitted to practise in England & Wales or another relevant UK or European jurisdiction, with significant experience advising on privacy and data protection matters.

  • Significant experience working in-house, balancing legal and regulatory requirements with commercial objectives and operating as a trusted advisor to the business.

  • Strong working knowledge of UK and European data protection law, with the ability to interpret legislation, regulatory guidance and emerging issues and translate them into clear, practical and commercially workable advice.

  • Experience not only providing privacy legal advice but also building, operating or materially contributing to a privacy programme, including areas such as DPIAs, RoPAs, privacy notices, data rights, retention, incident response and privacy governance.

  • The ability and willingness to work autonomously as Carwow’s principal in-house privacy specialist, moving comfortably between complex legal analysis and hands-on operational delivery.

  • Passionate about the intersection of AI and privacy, with an interest in how to safeguard the organisation during technology adoption while also leveraging AI to enhance and automate privacy operations.

  • A team player with a growth mindset, high EQ and low ego, excited to be part of a scale-up, high-growth company where every day brings new challenges and opportunities.

  • To be able to work in a fast-paced environment with teams that move and pivot quickly.

  • Fluency in English and strong written and verbal communication skills, together with a proactive, persuasive and adaptable manner.

  • Driven to ensure the Legal & Compliance Team is viewed as a genuine partner to the business, with the initiative and credibility to build relationships across functions and at senior levels.

  • Ability to lead cross-functional projects and influence stakeholders without relying on formal authority.

Who we are

Yubo is the Social Discovery app to make new friends and hang out online. By eliminating likes and follows, we empower our users to create genuine connections and show up as their true selves.

We've pioneered a new way for Gen Z to socialize online, and with millions of active users, our goal is to redefine how we connect today and tomorrow.

Our team is international, multicultural and deeply committed to its mission. As the leading platform to socialize online, we have a special responsibility to build a safe digital space for our community. Safety is embedded in our DNA, and our proactive approach focuses on user protection, support, and education.

Join us in this exciting journey and help us shape the future of social interactions!

About this role


At Yubo, Product Managers have real ownership. They work in strong partnership with Product Designers and Engineering, shaping strategy and decisions from problem definition all the way to delivery, with direct and visible impact on both the product and the business.

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to form that partnership with a Product Designer: a duo jointly responsible for the end-to-end experiences you ship together. You'll take ownership of a strategic product area, identify the biggest opportunities, and turn them into clear product bets on a product used by millions of people.

We're moving away from small, isolated feature launches toward bigger, end-to-end experiences tested at scale. You'll combine user understanding, data and strong product convictions to frame problems, shape solutions with Design and Engineering, and decide what to scale, iterate, or stop.

You'll also work closely with Data, Machine Learning, Brand Marketing and Trust & Safety on challenges ranging from recommendation and discovery to retention, safety, monetization and AI.

This role is particularly well suited to someone who enjoys balancing strategic thinking with hands-on execution, and who wants their decisions to have a visible impact on both user experience and business outcomes.

To make this dream duo work, we’re basing this role in Paris and looking for someone willing to come to the office once or twice a week.


Your responsibilities

  • Own a strategic product area from problem definition through delivery and post-launch iteration

  • Define product strategy and translate company objectives into clear priorities and measurable outcomes

  • Partner closely with Product Design and Engineering to shape end-to-end experiences rather than isolated features

  • Use data, research, user feedback, market insights, and product intuition to identify the problems worth solving

  • Turn opportunities into bold product bets, measure their impact, and decide whether to scale, iterate, or stop

  • Collaborate with Data, Machine Learning, Brand Marketing, Trust & Safety, and Legal to make informed product decisions

  • Balance user value, business impact, safety, and technical constraints when making trade-offs

  • Create alignment across stakeholders through clear problem framing, strong product conviction, and structured decision-making

  • Notion

  • Enterpret

Who you are

  • You have 4+ years of experience as a Product Manager, ideally within consumer mobile products and a startup or scale-up environment

  • You are comfortable owning a product area from problem definition through launch and iteration

  • You combine strong product intuition with analytical rigor

  • You know how to use data, research, user feedback, and experimentation to guide decisions

  • You start with the user problem rather than jumping straight to a feature or solution

  • You have the conviction to form a strong product point of view, make bold calls, and defend them

  • You enjoy working closely with Design and Engineering and leading through influence rather than hierarchy

  • You are comfortable making decisions with imperfect information and changing direction when the evidence tells you to

  • You know how to balance user experience with growth, engagement, monetization, safety, and long-term product health

  • Experience with social, community, social discovery, gaming, recommendation, or consumer subscription products is a plus

Within a month, you will

  • Get familiar with Yubo's product, users, business model, and product principles

  • Build relationships with your Product Designer and key stakeholders across Engineering, Data, Machine Learning, Brand Marketing, and Trust & Safety

  • Understand current product priorities, ongoing experiments, major user journeys, and the metrics behind them

  • Start contributing to discovery and product discussions

Within 3 months, you will

  • Take ownership of a defined product area and its key user and business problems

  • Establish a trusted way of working with your Product Designer and Engineering counterparts

  • Lead your first discovery work and turn your findings into clear product opportunities

  • Launch and analyze your first experiments, using their results to inform your next decisions

Within 6 months, you will

  • Lead ambitious product bets that rethink meaningful parts of the user experience rather than isolated features

  • Drive measurable progress on outcomes such as retention, engagement, recommendation quality, monetization, or trust

Join Yubo and help shape the future of Social Discovery while enjoying a culture that values flexibility, well-being, and impact.
